name: Purification Spring
description: A water body said to be able to wash off all filth and connect to the sea within the earth. Perhaps because of the many similar scents and memories, it is still inhabited by monsters that devoured the remains of greater life forms.

tabs.name: Sanctuary of Solemnity
tabs.description:
This was a temporary abode established outside the sea of flowers by the guardian priests of the true way in ancient times. Returning warriors and foreign pilgrims would fast and bathe here to cleanse themselves of impurity.
This is said to have been because only the pure and innocent were eligible to enter the temple of the Lord of Amrita.
